تحتملون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمِلُونَ (taḥtamilūna) /taħ.ta.mi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# تُحْتَمَلُونَ (tuḥtamalūna) /tuħ.ta.ma.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
